steps.observation: T2-GATEF-RUN6 modal-holds-locomotion audit. A walk that begins while a narrative modal still owns input does not fail as 'a modal is open' -- it fails as 'did not reach', many steps and sometimes many minutes later, which is how X04 lost its whole combat block to 3601 held frames. This assert is diagnostic and changes no behaviour: it turns that silent cascade into one named cause at the point of origin. RIG-25's rule, applied to narrative modals rather than to shop panels.

The previous target (-22,-16) is `playground_world.gd::HOUSE_AT` -- the house's own origin point, not where Grandpa stands. All three earlier attempts fell short of it by a shrinking but real margin (6.5m at 3000 frames, 5.9m at 6000), and even the successful arrival at attempt 3's 12000-frame run left the S10e-104 interact finding nobody, because `grandpa_house.gd::marker("grandpa")` places him at the house's local (-2.4,0,1.2) -- world (-24.4,-14.8), 2.68m from the old target -- and `sequence_director.gd`'s own `_grandpa_prompt` uses the same 3.8m default radius as a villager's. Retargeted directly at Grandpa's real marker with a tight close_enough so the arrival point is inside his prompt radius by construction, the same fix already applied to S10e-99. The door itself is not the obstacle: `_refresh_door_gate()` holds it open for any beat at or after `walk_out`, which this post-victory seed always is, so the walk-in is unblocked once aimed correctly.

steps.title: the whole walk-back was actually walked
steps.expected: Section 0.6: no pacing, navigation, difficulty or economy claim may come from a shortcut. This sub-segment (South Bridge to Grandpa's house, direct) is roughly 1.4-1.5 km measured; the SPLIT COST NOTE below records why the original whole-walk-back distance assertion (>= 7000 m) is now spread across S10c/S10d/S10e rather than checked once here.
steps.observation:
SPLIT NOTE: the original monolithic S10-108 asserted `distance_above: 7000` once, over the WHOLE walk-back (approach through Grandpa's, ~7.6 km). Splitting the walk into S10c/S10d/S10e means no single sub-segment's own `route.csv` sees the full distance, so that one assertion is replaced by a distance floor on EACH sub-segment (S10c/S10d implicitly via their own move_to budgets and this segment's own floor here), and the handover report is where the reassembled total across all three is reported and compared against the original 7000 m bar -- a claim about the whole walk-back, not about any one file, needs the whole run's saves/route.csv stitched together, not a single segment's assert.

GATE-F-LEG-S10CDE, floor corrected 3000.0 -> 1300.0: the 3000 m figure (like the 3.5 km estimate above it) does not match this leg's actual geography. S10d's own exit position (1.17,-2.88,1337.71) is a straight-line ~1354 m from the village gate (27.5,-16.0) alone; S10e attempt 3's real, un-shortcut walk (South Bridge -> village -> Grandpa's, before the NPC-targeting fix in this same restart) measured 1460.47 m end to end -- already under the old 3000 m floor even with nothing skipped. Cross-checked against the other two sub-segments' own final `distance_m` (S10c 3391.81 m, S10d 4235.49 m; total across all three ~9087 m, comfortably clearing the original whole-walk-back's 7000 m bar), so this leg being short is real geography, not a missing 1500+ m of unwalked route. 1300.0 stays a real floor -- a genuine teleport or skipped leg would still fail it -- without asserting a distance this direct a walk cannot honestly reach.
